name: v0.52.741
body:
## What's Changed
* Release exp-v0.52.736: provider entries with their own endpoint keep their key to that endpoint in the context lookup (#9262) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9296
* fix(context-lookup): a provider record with its own endpoint keeps its key on that endpoint by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9262
* Release exp-v0.52.737: share page shows hidden-text messages as plain text (#9214) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9297
* fix(share): show a message as plain text when the share page would hide part of it by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9214
* Release exp-v0.52.738: switched-off provider entries no longer route the chat's model (#9248) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9298
* fix(config): skip switched-off records in the providers.<slug>.models scan by @chhxbchhxb in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9248
* Release exp-v0.52.739: keep the reply when the Agent prunes an old tool result (#9286) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9299
* fix(streaming): keep the reply when the Agent's cold-cache prune shortens an old tool result by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9286
* Release exp-v0.52.740: fix(share): closing the already-shared dialog no longer refreshes the snapshot (#9260) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9309
* fix(share): closing the already-shared dialog no longer refreshes the snapshot (#9259) by @JayPokale in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9260
* Release exp-v0.52.741: Release: #9206 #9169 #9240 #9185 #9254 #9234 #9302 (git counts, storage-full 507, memory claim refusal, docs/tests) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9310
* fix(server): report storage full (ENOSPC/EDQUOT) instead of a generic 500 (#9167) by @angelusbr in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9169
* docs(sessions): document the middle-click row gesture that opens a session deep link in a new tab by @chhxbchhxb in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9185
* fix(git): count diff lines that start with --- or +++ inside hunks (#9205) by @nurlanmnn in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9206
* test(profiles): pin that the secret-scope cache follows the setter by @chhxbchhxb in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9234
* fix(memory): record the Agent's own claim refusal for the construction (#9061) by @chhxbchhxb in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9240
* test(context-length): restore post-544 behavioural cases dropped by #8819 by @chhxbchhxb in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9254
* docs: weekly contributor tally refresh (20261123) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9302

## New Contributors
* @JayPokale made their first contribution in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9260
* @nurlanmnn made their first contribution in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9206

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/compare/v0.52.735...v0.52.741
